about: The Workbench icons of the Gigalomania drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own gigalomania64.png (art/gigalomania.png, GPL 2 or later like the game). Gigalomania-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Gigalomania.info the program's. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Gigalomania.html and COPYING; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (gfx, islands, music, sound).
